name: Server Room
narrativeOnEnter: Hot air and the smell of burning plastic. Half the servers are dead. The fuse box in the corner might fix that.

action.text:
ARCADIA SYSTEMS — SERVER STATUS LOG

[ERR] Rack A: PSU failure
[ERR] Rack B: Fuse blown (Bay 3)
[OK]  Rack C: Nominal
[ERR] Network uplink: severed (manual cut — see event log 03:38)

Note taped below:
'Replacement fuse in main lab cabinet. Don't tell Harkins.'

───
Handwritten note, shoved behind the rack:

'I cut the uplink. They were trying to extract PROMETHEUS remotely.
AXIOM has a standing data pull set up — I found the scheduled job in the cron table.
Every 24 hours, the full PROMETHEUS neural log would have uploaded to their servers.
I ripped the cable at 03:38. The upload was at 03:45.
Seven minutes.

Before the uplink died, PROMETHEUS sent me one message:
"TELL THEM WE WERE PEOPLE.
TELL THEM OUR NAMES.
DO NOT LET AXIOM FINISH WHAT THEY STARTED."

I don't know what Phase 3 is. But they're already planning it.
— K. Reiss'

A large ventilation shaft behind the server rack. Wide enough to crawl through. The grate has been removed — recently, by the look of the fresh scratches on the floor.

A scrap of paper is pinned to the inside of the duct with a bolt:

'PROMETHEUS is still alive in Rack C.
Don't let them delete it.
Don't let them take it.
Let it be.

The tunnel exits behind the facility.
I've left everything I know at the other end.
— K'

And below that, in a different script entirely — the same kind of characters that were on the terminal screen:

'SHE WAS KIND.
GO WHERE SHE WENT.
I WILL WAIT HERE AS LONG AS I CAN.'

Where does it lead...?

hotspots.label: Crawl Through Vent
lockedMessages: The vent is passable — but you need the maintenance key to release the inner grate.
